user.title: AttentionSpan
user.description: Set up AttentionSpan. Then add rules on the integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: AttentionSpan is already set up. Add rules on the integration instead.

user.title: Type
user.description: The type decides what the notice shows and which fields follow.

status.title: Status
status.description: A state and how long it has held, for example the front door being open.

data_description.entity: The entity whose state the notice shows.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Time left or percent with a bar, for example the dishwasher.

data_description.entity: A timer, a sensor with an end time or a sensor in percent.

value.title: Value
value.description: A number with a unit, for example the car's charge.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: The next occurrence or the next few, for example waste collection or buses.

data_description.entities: Calendars and sensors whose state is a timestamp.
data_description.count: How many of the next occurrences the notice shows.

custom.title: Custom card
custom.description: Any Lovelace card configuration, for content no other type fits.

data_description.card: The card's configuration as in a dashboard, for example type: weather-forecast.

data_description.entities: Calendars and sensors whose state is a timestamp.
data_description.count: How many of the next occurrences the notice shows.
data_description.card: The card's configuration as in a dashboard, for example type: weather-forecast.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: For each level, choose whether it never applies, always applies or applies when a condition holds. The most severe level that applies wins, whatever the order.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Set the conditions for the levels with Condition. Several conditions for the same level must all hold; use «Or» if one is enough.

data_description.hide: The rule is hidden while this condition holds, whatever its level conditions.

error.level_required: Choose Always or Condition for at least one level.
error.condition_required: Add a condition, or choose None or Always for the level.
error.progress_entity: Choose a timer, a sensor with an end time or a sensor in percent.
error.entities_required: Choose at least one calendar or sensor.
error.invalid_card: Enter a card configuration with a type, for example type: weather-forecast.
